Class AccountManager<T extends Role>

java.lang.Object
AccountManager<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of Role this manager handles
Direct Known Subclasses:
AdminManager, LibrarianManager, UserManager
public abstract class AccountManager<T extends Role> extends Object
Abstract class that provides common account management functionality for different types of roles (e.g., Admin, Librarian, User).

This class manages accounts, usernames, passwords, login/logout status, and account creation. Subclasses must implement buildAccount(int, String, String, String) to define how accounts of type T are created.
